Good morning,

Please accept this as the first notice of loss for Summit Ridge Construction Inc. under policy CPP-6612078.

Reported incident: water intrusion and resulting interior damage discovered at a project site while work was in progress. Please advise on claim assignment, any immediate next steps, and whether you need photos, site address, or preliminary estimates. The loss is being reported as soon as practicable after discovery.

Named insured: Summit Ridge Construction Inc.
Policy number: CPP-6612078
Requested effective date for claim handling: 01/15/2026

Thank you,
Derek Olsson
Summit Ridge Construction Inc.

Note: the policy number on the attachment may be off by a digit; the correct one ends in 9.
